tasks.description: Remove the dist/ output directory so the next build starts from a clean slate.
Compile TypeScript to dist/ (skipping typecheck — that's a separate gate) and mark the bin executable.
Regenerate schema.json from the zod ConfigSchema source of truth.
Read-only Biome check (lint + format) across the repo.
Type-check the project with tsgo (Microsoft's native TS preview) without emitting output.
Run the full Vitest suite once (unit + e2e) in non-watch mode.

Auto-fix Biome lint and formatting issues across the repo.
Run a single Vitest file, optionally filtered by test-name pattern.

Create a new changeset interactively: pick a bump (patch/minor/major) and write a one-line summary that becomes the next changelog entry. The release bot picks up the resulting .changeset/*.md file on next push to master and opens (or updates) a 'Version Packages' PR. NOTE: interactive — stdin doesn't reach the child from inside the TUI; run from a non-TUI shell (`pnpm exec changeset` or `pnpm start changeset --ci`).

Consume every pending changeset: bump package.json, prepend the changelog, and delete the .changeset/*.md files. Normally run by the release bot inside its 'Version Packages' PR; only invoke locally for one-off manual releases when the bot is broken.

Publish every bumped package to npm. `prepublishOnly` (regen schema + tsc + chmod the bin) runs automatically per-package, so the published artifact always carries fresh dist/ and schema.json. Used by the release workflow after the Version PR is merged.
